districts.name: New Smyrna Beach
districts.description: A laid back surf town about an hour from Orlando.
districts.centerMeaning: Representative OSM town place-label anchor: New Smyrna Beach
districts.priceStatus: Published market median; reporting period shown on card.

scale.notes: Use OSM height, then levels. Only houses without either default to 1–2 stories. Apartments/condos/hotels/resorts and footprints >=1500 m² within 300 m of mapped beach use explicit, flagged type/area estimates when height and levels are absent. Retain 3x display scale and width caps.

coastalBuildings.note: Estimated storeys = clamp(round(4 + sqrt(footprint m²)/10),4,20), only when OSM height and levels are absent. Beach proximity is measured to mapped natural=beach polygons. This is an illustration estimate, not building research.
